name: Classic Envelope
reason: Ivory card under a thin double gold Mughal arch with star finial - exactly the client's brief; calm, classic, perfectly legible.

name: Rose Garden
reason: Painted crimson-rose and leaf corners on cream with a hairline gold frame - the client's soft florals, rich enough for a Baraat. Rendered with the closing line left empty and venue 'Noor Mahal Marquee, Islamabad' so nothing touches the flowers.

name: Gold Foil Press
reason: Ivory art-deco gold-foil frame with sunburst fans and maroon accents - a crisp, formal look unlike any arch. Rendered with the closing line empty and the short venue so the text clears the fans.

name: Wine & Pearl
reason: Pearl-strand swags with two small lanterns on soft blush-white, wine ink - delicate, distinctly different ornament; all text clear.

name: Moon & Lanterns
reason: Thin gold arch on midnight navy with ivory script - the rich, evening-Baraat version of the classic arch.

name: Qalam aur Siyahi
reason: Gold arch on textured plum-brown paper - rich Baraat colour with a tactile, stationery feel.

name: Dulha Dulhan Curtains
reason: Maroon and antique-gold carved jharokha frame - the most regal, deep-coloured Baraat option (twinkling sparkles off so none sits on the name).

name: Doli Rukhsati
reason: Ivory carved jharokha topped with a rose-and-marigold toran - festive Baraat touch kept refined; maroon names.

name: Jharokha Window
reason: Ivory and soft-gold Mughal jharokha with dome and jaali - traditional, balanced, generous spacing.

name: Emerald Darbar
reason: Jharokha darbar frame with emerald ink - royal Mughal mood in a distinctive colour (sparkles off).

name: Vintage Garden
reason: Soft painted watercolour florals washed behind the text, thin gold frame - gentle 'painted florals' feel (sparkles off).

name: Handmade Paper
reason: Deckle-edge handmade-paper texture with a gold swag garland and forest-green ink - artisanal and understated (sparkles off).

name: Kashmiri Saffron
reason: Ivory with gold corner frames, saffron 'Baraat' and chocolate script - warm, classic Kashmiri palette (sparkles off).

name: Marble Minimal
reason: White marble with gold veining and a hairline gold frame - contemporary luxury, very clean.

name: White Roses Noir
reason: Black and gold with a laurel 'A & L' monogram - dramatic, formal alternative for an evening-style Baraat card.
